target.title: fix: confirm identity-less Claude reset samples
target.body:
## Summary

- require a second low-usage sample before celebrating a Claude reset when the observation has no account identity and therefore uses the shared `claude:claude` detector key
- preserve compatibility with previously persisted detector state
- add coverage for a transient simultaneous session/weekly low sample followed by recovery, plus a real reset confirmed by the next sample

## Root cause

Identity-less Claude CLI probe samples share one persisted detector key. A transient partial/near-zero CLI read can therefore look like a reset for both the session and weekly windows. The detector previously posted immediately on the first threshold crossing.

## Behavior

Only the low-confidence shared Claude path waits for one subsequent low sample (one refresh interval). Identified accounts retain the existing immediate behavior.

## Test

- `swift test --filter "UsageStorePlanUtilizationTests"` (72 tests passed)

Fixes #2222.
